Class CompletionStageDisposable<T>

java.lang.Object
io.reactivex.rxjava4.core.CompletionStageDisposable<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the return and element type of the various stages
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class CompletionStageDisposable<T> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Consist of a terminal stage and a disposable to be able to cancel a sequence.
Since:
4.0.0

    • await

      public void await()
      Await the completion of the current stage.

      Rethrows any original unchecked exceptions as is.

      Throws:
      CancellationException - if the computation was cancelled
      CompletionException - if the original exception was a checked exception
